$comment: Declarative companion to DEPLOY.md. DEPLOY.md is authoritative; this file exists so a deploy agent can parse facts directly instead of scraping prose. Update both together or not at all.
name: cowork

required_env.name: DIARY_AUTH_TOKEN
required_env.purpose: Shared bearer token for web->diary calls and the base for the web UI's own API auth
required_env.note: Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Empty disables UI API auth entirely; set before any network exposure.

required_env.name: INFERENCE_BASE_URL
required_env.purpose: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (should end in /v1) used by both containers
required_env.note: Ask the human for their endpoint; host.docker.internal works for loopback services on the Docker host.

required_env.name: INFERENCE_API_KEY
required_env.purpose: Bearer key for the inference endpoint, if it authenticates
required_env.condition: only if the inference endpoint requires a key

required_env.name: PUBLIC_ORIGIN
required_env.purpose: Public URL humans browse to; locks the auth origin allow-list and derives the passkey ID

required_env.name: COWORK_PORT
required_env.purpose: Host port for the web UI

required_env.name: COWORK_STATE_DIR
required_env.purpose: Host directory for all durable state (diary corpus + SQLite journal, web accounts/secrets)

required_env.name: DIARY_CHAT_MODEL
required_env.purpose: Chat model name the inference endpoint serves

required_env.name: DIARY_AUX_MODEL
required_env.purpose: Auxiliary classification model name

required_env.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
required_env.purpose: Embedding model name for retrieval

required_env.name: UI_AUTH_TOKEN
required_env.purpose: Optional distinct UI API token

required_env.name: WEBAUTHN_RP_ID
required_env.purpose: Passkey identifier; must match the browser hostname

required_env.name: TRUST_PROXY
required_env.purpose: true only behind a reverse proxy, so rate limiting/audit logs see real client IPs

required_env.name: LEGACY_AUTH_COMPAT
required_env.purpose: Allows machine clients to authenticate with the shared token

required_env.name: AUX_INFERENCE_BASE_URL
required_env.purpose: Optional separate endpoint for the diary's auxiliary classification model

required_env.name: DEFAULT_PROVIDER_ID
required_env.purpose: ID of the pre-seeded default inference provider entry

required_env.name: DEFAULT_PROVIDER_LABEL
required_env.purpose: Display label of the pre-seeded default inference provider

required_env.name: DIARY_MONTH_FILE_TEMPLATE
required_env.purpose: Filename template for diary month files

required_env.name: DIARY_ENTRY_LAYOUT
required_env.purpose: Diary entry layout (daily or monthly)

required_env.name: DIARY_ENTRIES_PREFIX
required_env.purpose: Heading prefix for diary entries in month files

required_env.name: DIARY_INDEX_ENABLED
required_env.purpose: Enable the sidecar retrieval index

required_env.name: DIARY_LEGACY_USER_ID
required_env.purpose: Optional one-release direct Diary API mapping for legacy clients

required_env.name: COWORK_VERSION
required_env.purpose: Image tag for built images

required_env.name: CORPUS_BACKEND
required_env.purpose: Diary storage backend (local or webdav)

required_env.name: CORPUS_ROOT
required_env.purpose: Corpus root for the chosen backend

required_env.name: WEBDAV_BASE_URL
required_env.purpose: WebDAV server URL when CORPUS_BACKEND=webdav

required_env.name: WEBDAV_USERNAME
required_env.purpose: WebDAV username

required_env.name: WEBDAV_PASSWORD
required_env.purpose: WebDAV password

required_env.name: S3_ENDPOINT_URL
required_env.purpose: S3-compatible endpoint (MinIO, Backblaze B2, AWS S3, Garage, ...) when CORPUS_BACKEND=s3; path-style addressing

required_env.name: S3_BUCKET
required_env.purpose: S3 bucket name when CORPUS_BACKEND=s3

required_env.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
required_env.purpose: S3 access key ID; empty enables unsigned mode for public/position-authed buckets

required_env.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
required_env.purpose: S3 secret access key

required_env.name: S3_SESSION_TOKEN
required_env.purpose: Optional S3 session token for temporary credentials

required_env.name: S3_REGION
required_env.purpose: S3 region for SigV4 scope

required_env.name: S3_PREFIX
required_env.purpose: Optional key prefix inside the S3 bucket

required_env.name: DIARY_EXTERNAL_SOURCES
required_env.purpose: Comma-separated mounted folders of pre-existing .txt/.md journal files offered (read-only) for import in the diary empty state

required_env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_KIND
required_env.purpose: Optional local model-manager integration

required_env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_BASE_URL
required_env.purpose: Model-manager base URL

required_env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_API_KEY
required_env.purpose: Model-manager API key

post_deploy_human_steps: Retrieve the one-time first-run setup code: docker compose logs web | grep 'FIRST-RUN SETUP CODE' (or cat /app/server/ui-data/first-run-setup-code inside the web container).

Open PUBLIC_ORIGIN in a browser and complete the setup wizard: enter the setup code, create the admin account, check the inference provider, choose diary and display preferences, optionally add a passkey.
Log one diary entry from the UI and confirm it appears (proves diary write path end to end).
